decisions.decision: Represent Ethereum and XRPL attacker receivers as separate chain-specific nodes.
decisions.reason: CoinDesk identifies Ethereum receiver addresses 0x5227... and 0x8532...; the five XRPL source wallets transfer to rK21... . No direct wallet-level cross-chain mapping is established.

decisions.decision: Keep common incident attribution at the event level, not as a wallet-to-wallet edge.
decisions.reason: Shared timing and Binance incident context do not prove common beneficial ownership or operator identity.

decisions.decision: Preserve the earlier graph unchanged and supersede it with this corrected graph.
